Daily Devotional

March 5

3 Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience. 4 But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing. (James 1:3-4 KJV)

This is talking about how we should act under trials and temptations. It does not say that God causes these trials and temptations (James 1:13), but that our faith will work patience in us during such times (Romans 5:3). Patience is faith over a period of time and comes from scripture (Romans 10:17, 15:4). The devil is the one that puts trials in our lives, and if you are serving God, you will be persecuted by the devil (2 Timothy 3:12).

Some people have been taught that God sends the trials and temptations into our lives, but that is not so (Mark 4:17). If you think these things come from God, you would tend to not resist them, but they come from the devil, and must be resisted (James 4:7). To resist means to “actively fight against” the devil. If you fail to resist the devil, you have given over to him, and he will destroy you (John 10:10). So what we need to do is fight our way through all the trials in life, and with our faith being under test, it will make our patience become perfect and entire. Praise God that we have His strength to see us through our trials.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
